rules.source_quote: FIRST SCHEDULE (Section 2). A resident individual is entitled to a personal relief in arriving at taxable income for a year of assessment as provided for in the First Schedule to this Act.
Personal relief for a resident individual for YA 2024/25: one million two hundred thousand rupees per year of assessment (First Schedule / IRD Tax Chart 2024/25).
Personal relief for a resident individual commencing YA 2025/26 has been increased to one million eight hundred thousand rupees (Act No. 02 of 2025 / IRD PN IT/2025-01).
FIRST SCHEDULE (Section 2). The tax on the taxable income of a resident individual for a year of assessment shall be computed at the rates set out in the First Schedule to this Act.

First Schedule progressive rates for YA 2024/25 (resident individual): First Rs. 500,000 at 6%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 12%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 18%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 24%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 30%; On the Balance at 36%.

First Schedule progressive rates for YA 2025/26 (Act No. 02 of 2025): First Rs. 1,000,000 at 6%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 18%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 24%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 30%; On the Balance at 36% (12% bracket removed).
